digest.component_or_area: Jira coordinator — create and binding lifecycle
propositions: Create operations must durably persist the pending-binding intent before any provider call, and pre-create persistence failure must produce zero Jira calls and return item-scoped failure.

After Jira returns a key, the canonical rebar-id label must be attached first, entity property enrichment attempted second as optional, and any binding/persistence failure must report the known key without deleting the remote issue.
Create timeout or connection loss must never trigger blind replay; observation through replay-safe identity/query seams or a deferred pending record must prevent duplicate creation across restart.
Keyed recovery must perform zero search queries; keyless recovery must require both three misses and 3600-second conjunction before declaring non-existence.

Lifecycle intents after create must execute only after proven remote postconditions; create-before-link, hierarchy deferral, tombstone suppression, and filtered/read-only behavior must remain effective.
